> **0.6.0**: the sound engine is now the LXR-02's own, from the Erica Synths firmware Erica open-sourced (GPL-3.0): its
> voices, filters, PWM, modulation and the real FX unit, plus its plate reverb (off in the hardware firmware). The
> panel, randomizers, RESET, PARAMETERS column and pad control are unchanged. LXR-02 kits play as they do on the
> machine, pulse width and FX modulation included. The factory project keeps both preset sets: the Hrtl DLC kits as
> the LXR-02 plays them and as 0.5 shipped them ("05"), plus both init kits. MPC projects and saved projects from 0.5.x
> open and are converted. Installs over 0.5.x in place.

LXRXXL for MPC OS 3.x (Akai Force / MPC), armv7. Unzip, then follow INSTALL.md (root SSH access, e.g. MockbaMod).
`LXRXXL-<version>-mpc-armv7.zip` is the plugin; `LXRXXL-<version>-source.zip` its complete source (GPL-3.0).
See CHANGELOG.md for what changed.
